Great vegetarian restaurant
Dec 2019 • Couples
This restaurant is fully vegetarian which was great for us as we had a wide variety of options to choose from. We took the noodle soup and vegetables curry the first time we went and thoroughly enjoyed it. They use a variety of meat alternatives (tofu, seitan, tempeh) which is great. Actually the food was so good that we returned the next day for the soup and tried the vegan burger as well. Other than taste, this place has friendly staff and the prices are very affordable! (40k / soup, 50k/ burger). We will definitely come back here if we return to Tam Coc!

Jun 2019 • Friends
We went to Buddha Belly on someone’s recommendation. I was looking forward to it having heard good reviews about their veggie food and having found it difficult to find so far in Vietnam. However, the Vietnamese menu isn’t anything you can’t order at a normal place (rice/noodles with vegetables, veg spring rolls etc). They do offer a veg burger but I chose not to get this after walking past the kitchen and seeing a stack of them piled up with flies all over (this might explain another person’s review below about getting sick from it!)

Give it a miss!
